properties.description: For Markdown files, add a reusable IconToggleButton to the text editor view toolbar to switch between the raw editable source and rendered Markdown. Reuse RelationalUi's existing MarkdownElement (Systems/Depth2/RelationalUi/Depth0/Markdown/index.ts), exported through @super-app/relational-ui-contributor/markdown/source and backed by its existing markdown-it dependency. Render the current editor contents, including unsaved edits, and preserve the draft and save state when switching modes. Supply clear state/action tooltips. Other file types keep their existing presentation.
properties.title: Toggle rendered Markdown and raw text in the text editor
